title: Azure Synapse Pipelines Failures by Pipeline
app: Azure Synapse pipeline diagnostics via Azure Monitor/Event Hub to HEC.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=azure:synapse:pipeline status="Failed"
| stats count as failures, latest(_time) as last_failure by pipeline_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts Azure Synapse Pipelines failures grouped by pipeline so operators immediately see which specific pipelines are broken rather than a single global failure number.
value: Object-level failure attribution turns a vague 'Azure Synapse Pipelines is failing' alert into an actionable list of exactly what to fix first.
implementation: Ingest Azure Synapse Pipelines failure events; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for business-critical pipelines.
visualization: Table of pipeline by failure count and last failure time.
grandmaExplanation: We tell you exactly which parts of Azure Synapse Pipelines are failing, not just that something is wrong, so the right thing gets fixed first.
